<p>BIM 工程師(儲備培訓)</p><h3>工作內容</h3><h4>BIM:
BIM Engineer (Trainee Program)

Responsibilities

BIM modeling and coordination

  • Build and revise BIM models in AutoCAD and Revit
  • BIM coordination and drawing reviews

On-site collaboration

  • Assist with site surveys at the construction site
  • Handle tasks assigned by your supervisor

On-the-job training

  • Carry out BIM work under the project contract while receiving the company's full training

Requirements

Must have
  • Willing to work full-time on site and follow the site schedule (two days off a week, no rotating shifts)
  • Able to work fully on site at the Houli, Taichung plant area long term
  • After being hired, complete 6 hours of occupational safety training and obtain the certificate before your start date (the construction-industry "green card"; you can take the course near you and claim the cost back from the company with a receipt)
Nice to have
  • Experience with AutoCAD, Revit or other drafting/modeling software is a plus
  • Engineering or design-related work experience is a plus
  • Interest in BIM or construction, and keen to learn and grow within an on-site team
<p>BIM工程師(儲備培訓)</p><h3>工作內容</h3><h4>技術培訓:
BIM Engineer (Trainee Program)

Responsibilities

Technical training and growth

  • The company provides basic AutoCAD training, covering 2D drawing creation and revision and how to read engineering drawings
  • Once you have the AutoCAD basics, you move on to learning Revit 3D modeling

Requirements

Required
  • Bachelor's degree or above, any major (related majors preferred)
  • Able to communicate fluently in Chinese
  • Motorcycle license
  • Able to work on-site at a semiconductor fab campus in Hsinchu and complete occupational safety training
  • Mature, steady work attitude with good resilience under pressure; willing to train and follow team and project assignments
Preferred
  • Basic hands-on AutoCAD experience
  • Exposure to Revit or other 3D modeling tools
  • Ability to read engineering drawings
  • Interest in the semiconductor industry, MEP systems, and BIM technology
  • Background in electrical, mechanical (including HVAC and energy), industrial design, civil (including construction), architecture, or related majors
